label: Christmas Postcard
css: #dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"]{background:#1a1210;container-type:size;}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .dyn-stage{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .card{width:86cqw;height:78cqh;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f6efe4,#e7d8c4);border-radius:1.4cqh;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr 1fr;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 2cqh 6cqh rgba(0,0,0,.4);outline:1px solid rgba(120,80,40,.25)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .photo-pane{position:relative;margin:2.4cqh;border-radius:1cqh;overflow:hidden;background:#222}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .photo-pane img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .stamp{position:absolute;top:3%;right:3%;width:22%;aspect-ratio:1;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") center/80% no-repeat,#fff8;border:2px dashed #c0392b;border-radius:.4cqh;box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .copy-pane{padding:5cqh 4cqw 4cqh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:2.5cqh;position:relative}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .holly-mark{position:absolute;top:3cqh;right:3cqw;width:min(22%,90px);aspect-ratio:1;background:url("data:image/webp;base64,") center/contain no-repeat;opacity:.95}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .pc-msg{flex:1 1 auto;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Cormorant Garamond",serif;color:#2c1b14;line-height:1.28}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .pc-msg span{display:block}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .pc-name{height:7cqh;overflow:hidden;font-family:"Special Elite",serif;color:#c0392b;letter-spacing:.03em}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .pc-name span{display:block}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .slot-logo{position:absolute;top:3%;left:3%;width:min(10%,110px);aspect-ratio:1}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .slot-qr{position:absolute;bottom:3%;right:3%;width:min(10%,110px);aspect-ratio:1}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"].on .card{animation:xmas-pc-in .7s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1) both}#dyn-message-theme[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"].off .card{opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s ease}#dyn-message-theme.dyn-portrait[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .card{width:88cqw;height:86cqh;grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:1.05fr .95fr}#dyn-message-theme.dyn-portrait[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .photo-pane{margin:2cqh 2cqh 0}#dyn-message-theme.dyn-portrait[data-theme="message-xmas-postcard"] .copy-pane{padding:3cqh 4cqw 3cqh}@keyframes xmas-pc-in{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(4cqh) rotate(-1deg)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
